subject: Seven Acre Cemetery Expansion Project
overview: The board reviewed schematic designs for World War I Memorial accessibility and discussed layout revisions for the Seven Acre cemetery expansion. Key discussions focused on balancing burial plot density with environmental preservation and addressing maintenance failures at the World War II memorial fountain.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September meeting.

items.title: World War I Memorial Accessibility Designs
items.summary: Reviewed schematic options for ADA-compliant pathways and parking at the memorial hill, with the board favoring a hybrid layout estimated between $140,000 and $150,000.

items.title: Seven Acre Expansion Project
items.summary: Discussed compromising between burial plot maximization and aesthetic buffers to address stakeholder concerns regarding trail connectivity and the proposed maintenance yard. The project will proceed toward a public-facing process involving the Mayor and community stakeholders.

items.title: Operational and Signage Updates
items.summary: Noted the installation of dog prohibition signs at Salem Street and received updates on soil hauling, the service building project, and departmental staffing shortages.

items.title: World War II Memorial Fountain Maintenance
items.summary: Discussed persistent issues with duck waste and the lack of a proper vacuuming system, resulting in the decision to keep the fountain shut down until a maintenance plan is established.
